target.statement: Best enhanced classical model R2 on the SAMPL dataset (hydration free energy), reported as 0.91 ± 0.02 by the Gradient Boosting ensemble.

code_links: GitHub repository mentioned in conclusion but no URL given in the PDF

compute.basis: Small 642-molecule dataset, RDKit/Mordred descriptor computation plus Gradient Boosting with 5-fold CV on CPU; paper claims <5 min training, so most time is install and descriptor generation.

blockers: No code URL is actually provided in the PDF text (only a claim that code is on GitHub), so the exact feature set and hyperparameters must be re-implemented from the description
D(G) and ζ(G) definitions are given but the exact implementation (e.g., irregularity index t(v)) must be inferred
Mordred descriptor package can be slow to install/compile
title: Graph-Theoretic Models for the Prediction of Molecular Measurements
